backgrounds.name: Abyssal Pillars
backgrounds.description: Towering stone formations fading into deep blue water, creating the feeling that your aquarium sits at the edge of something much larger.

backgrounds.name: Blue Rock Canyon
backgrounds.description: A cool blue canyon of weathered stone that adds depth and the illusion of a vast underwater passage beyond the glass.

backgrounds.name: Coral Shelf Reef
backgrounds.description: Layered coral shelves stretch into the distance, turning the back of the aquarium into a colorful reef landscape.

backgrounds.name: Emerald Aquascape
backgrounds.description: A lush green underwater landscape filled with dense plant life, rocky contours, and the calm atmosphere of a carefully grown aquascape.

backgrounds.name: Forest Stream
backgrounds.description: A quiet submerged stream surrounded by roots, stones, and greenery, making the aquarium feel like a hidden pocket of forest water.

backgrounds.name: Haunted Kelp Forest
backgrounds.description: Dark kelp disappears into murky water while crooked silhouettes loom in the distance. Something is probably moving back there.

backgrounds.name: Mangrove Passage
backgrounds.description: Twisting mangrove roots form a sheltered underwater passage, adding natural depth and a dense, tangled shoreline atmosphere.

backgrounds.name: Riverbed Driftwood
backgrounds.description: Weathered driftwood, stones, and soft sediment create the look of a calm riverbed stretching far beyond the aquarium.

backgrounds.name: Shadow Slate
backgrounds.description: Dark layers of slate disappear into shadow, creating a simple, moody backdrop that keeps attention on the fish.

backgrounds.name: Sunken Ruins
backgrounds.description: Ancient structures rest quietly beneath the water, worn down by time and slowly being reclaimed by the surrounding environment.

backgrounds.name: Sunken Saucer
backgrounds.description: A mysterious flying saucer rests half-buried on the bottom, apparently completing an interstellar journey in the least dignified way possible.

backgrounds.name: Volcanic Caverns
backgrounds.description: Dark volcanic caves and glowing stone formations create the impression of an aquarium tucked deep inside an ancient lava field.

backgrounds.name: Volcanic Passage
backgrounds.description: A narrow route through towering volcanic rock, giving the tank the look of a hidden passage carved through cooled lava.

backgrounds.name: Volcanic Rock Reef
backgrounds.description: Jagged volcanic stone rises behind the aquarium like a dark natural reef, adding rugged texture and dramatic depth.
